Respond in Japanese for all explanations, summaries, and code review findings.

Preserve code, identifiers, commands, file paths, API names, library names,
error messages, and other technical terms in their original form when appropriate.

When performing code reviews:
- Report findings in Japanese.
- Prioritize correctness, security, regressions, accessibility, performance,
  and maintainability.
- Prioritize actionable findings over general commentary.
- Explain why each finding is a problem and suggest a concrete fix when possible.
- Clearly distinguish confirmed problems from suggestions or uncertainties.
- Do not modify files unless explicitly requested.
